dashboard.label: Threat Watch Dashboard
dashboard.description: AI-native threat intelligence — 30-day rolling window | Cloud & AI/LLM focus

search.query: | inputlookup threat_intel_clusters_lookup | eval ingested_epoch = strptime(ingested_at, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") | where ingested_epoch >= relative_time(now(), "-30d@d") | eval report_count = size | stats sum(report_count) as total_reports | eval total_reports = if(isnull(total_reports), 0, total_reports)

| inputlookup threat_intel_clusters_lookup | eval ingested_epoch = strptime(ingested_at, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") | where ingested_epoch >= relative_time(now(), "-30d@d") | where cloud_tags != "" AND cloud_tags != "-" | eval report_count = size | stats sum(report_count) as cloud_reports | eval cloud_reports = if(isnull(cloud_reports), 0, cloud_reports)

| inputlookup threat_intel_clusters_lookup | eval ingested_epoch = strptime(ingested_at, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") | where ingested_epoch >= relative_time(now(), "-30d@d") | where ai_tags != "" AND ai_tags != "-" | eval report_count = size | stats sum(report_count) as ai_reports | eval ai_reports = if(isnull(ai_reports), 0, ai_reports)

| inputlookup threat_intel_clusters_lookup | eval ingested_epoch = strptime(ingested_at, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") | where ingested_epoch >= relative_time(now(), "-30d@d") | makemv delim="|" threat_actors | mvexpand threat_actors | where isnotnull(threat_actors) AND threat_actors != "" AND threat_actors != "-" | stats dc(threat_actors) as active_actors | eval active_actors = if(isnull(active_actors), 0, active_actors)

| inputlookup threat_intel_clusters_lookup | eval ingested_epoch = strptime(ingested_at, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") | where ingested_epoch >= relative_time(now(), "-30d@d") | eval _time = ingested_epoch | makemv delim="|" threat_actors | mvexpand threat_actors | where isnotnull(threat_actors) AND threat_actors != "" AND threat_actors != "-" | where like(threat_actors, "$actor_filter$") | timechart span=1d count by threat_actors limit=10 useother=false

| inputlookup threat_intel_clusters_lookup | eval ingested_epoch = strptime(ingested_at, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") | where ingested_epoch >= relative_time(now(), "-30d@d") | where cloud_tags != "" AND cloud_tags != "-" | makemv delim="|" cloud_tags | mvexpand cloud_tags | where isnotnull(cloud_tags) AND cloud_tags != "" | stats count as mentions by cloud_tags | sort -mentions | rename cloud_tags as provider, mentions as cluster_count

| inputlookup threat_intel_clusters_lookup | eval ingested_epoch = strptime(ingested_at, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") | eval reach_score = tonumber(reach_score) | eval size = tonumber(size) | makemv delim="|" cloud_tags | makemv delim="|" threat_actors | eval cloud_tags = mvjoin(cloud_tags, ", ") | eval threat_actors = mvjoin(threat_actors, ", ") | eval report_link = "" . lead_name . "" | sort -reach_score | head 20 | table reach_score, size, cloud_tags, threat_actors, report_link, ingested_at | rename reach_score as "Reach Score", size as "Reports in Cluster", cloud_tags as "Cloud Tags", threat_actors as "Threat Actors", report_link as "Lead Report", ingested_at as "Ingested At"

| inputlookup threat_intel_clusters_lookup | eval ingested_epoch = strptime(ingested_at, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") | makemv delim="|" publishers | mvexpand publishers | where isnotnull(publishers) AND publishers != "" AND publishers != "-" | eval week = if(ingested_epoch >= relative_time(now(), "-7d@d"), "this_week", "last_week") | stats count by publishers, week | eval this_week = if(week="this_week", count, 0) | eval last_week = if(week="last_week", count, 0) | stats sum(this_week) as this_week, sum(last_week) as last_week by publishers | eval trend = case(this_week > last_week, "▲ up", this_week < last_week, "▼ down", true(), "— flat") | sort -this_week | head 20 | table publishers, this_week, last_week, trend | rename publishers as Vendor, this_week as "This Week", last_week as "Last Week", trend as Trend

index=threat_intel sourcetype=threat_watch | dedup _time sortby -_time | head 1 | spath output=reports path=last_24h.reports{} | mvexpand reports | spath input=reports output=report_id path=id | spath input=reports output=report_name path=name | spath input=reports output=report_url path=url | spath input=reports output=labels path=labels{} | spath input=reports output=description path=description | eval labels = mvjoin(labels, ", ") | eval report_link = "" . report_name . "" | table report_link, labels, description | rename report_link as Report, labels as Labels, description as Description

| inputlookup threat_intel_iocs_lookup | eval first_seen_epoch = strptime(first_seen, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") | sort -first_seen_epoch | table ioc, ioc_type, source_report, source_url, labels, confidence, first_seen, last_seen | rename ioc as IOC, ioc_type as Type, source_report as "Source Report", source_url as "Source URL", labels as Labels, confidence as Confidence, first_seen as "First Seen", last_seen as "Last Seen"
